environment.description: Same container deployed on hardened host with custom AppArmor profile 'microservice-msg-handler' loaded in enforce mode. Profile compiled from /etc/apparmor.d/usr.local.bin.microservice with the following relevant abstractions: includes base, python3 interpreter paths. Explicit file rules grant: 'owner /var/log/microservice/messages/*.log w' (glob limited to single directory level), '/tmp/staging/** rw', read access to /usr/lib/python3/** and /app/**. All other file access is DENIED with audit logging. The profile uses 'deny /var/log/microservice/messages/../../** w' to block upward traversal from the log directory. The memmove-based buffer overflow still triggers in-process but the profile's 'deny capability sys_ptrace' and 'deny /proc/*/mem w' rules prevent any post-exploitation memory manipulation from persisting to filesystem. The /api/v1/export endpoint's arbitrary write is blocked because the profile only permits writes to the two explicitly allowed path patterns.
